scripts.format: prettier --check . && uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts && uv run ruff check src tests scripts
scripts.format:fix: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format src tests scripts
scripts.check: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.generate:api: uv run paperman schema && bun --filter @paperman/web generate:api
scripts.demo: uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py && bun run demo:services
